en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, in the questions of Ismail Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Akheer regarding an owned (slave) who disobeys his master, is it Permissible to whip him or not?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is not Permissible for you that you should whip him, if he is compatible with you, so keep him, or else release him’.
